communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想汇报消融实验（Table 2）：证明我们的模块 A、模块 B 和正则项 C 每一个都不可或缺，且各自负责解决不同的特定子问题。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：CET6_Essay 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT19 (六级写作（CET-6）满分范文：高校教学中生成式 AI 辅助与独立批判性思维培养的平衡之道)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP33 -> BP34 -> BP35`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Table 2 shows the ablation study. Without Module A, MSE increases from 0.180 to 0.215. Without Module B, MSE increases to 0.204. Without Loss C, MSE increases to 0.195. Thus, every part is necessary.
structural_constraints: S1 [消融实验总括 Ablation Setup]：To isolate the contribution of each architectural component, we evaluate four ablated variants in Table 2 by progressively removing [Mod A], [Mod B], and [Loss C].

S2 [移除模块 A 的冲击与归因 Impact of Removing Mod A]：Removing [Mod A] (w/o A) causes the largest degradation on [Non-stationary/Volatile Subset], increasing MSE by [X%] because the model loses [Specific Capability A].

S3 [移除模块 B 的冲击与归因 Impact of Removing Mod B]：Similarly, replacing [Mod B] with standard [Naive Operator] degrades performance by [Y%] on high-dimensional benchmarks, confirming its role in [Specific Capability B].
S4 [协同效应总结 Synergistic Conclusion]：Combining all components yields super-additive gains, as [Mod A] stabilizes input statistics for [Mod B]'s relational reasoning.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: 学术演讲收尾页 & Q&A 现场问答
domain_context: 托福独立与综合写作：理论基础与工程实践权衡
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想用于演讲最后一页总结（Take-home Messages）以及回答台下教授/审稿人犀利提问时的标准应答模板。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP44` 与全文样板 `FT19` 的后半部分（`BP37 -> BP40`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: In recent years, many works studied time series foundation models. TimeGPT trained a transformer on large data. Moment used masked pre-training. Chronos quantized time series into tokens. Lag-Llama used lag features. However, our model is different from them.
structural_constraints: S1 [凝练核心带走信息 Core Take-Home Message]：To wrap up, if there is one takeaway from our work today, it is that [One-Sentence Core Principle].
S2 [成果三点速览 Rapid Recap]：By combining [A] and [B], [Model] delivers [Metric 1], [Metric 2], and [Open-Source/Practical Asset].
S3 [Q&A 礼貌接招与结论前置 Q&A Direct Answer]：(For Q&A) That is a great question regarding [Topic]—the short answer is [Direct Conclusion].
S4 [Q&A 展开与诚实边界 Q&A Elaboration]：In our current experiments, we observed [Empirical Fact], and extending this to [Questioner's Scenario] can be handled by [Concrete Mechanism].
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
